0022600126.text: The Memphis Grizzlies (3-0, on a three-game win streak and 2nd in the Southwest division) visit the Utah Jazz (1-2, on a one-game losing streak and 5th in the Northwest, 2 games back) for the Grizzlies' fourth game of the 2026-27 season. Memphis leads the 2026-27 season series 1-0 after winning 123-103 in Memphis on October 21, 2026, and the teams split the 2025-26 series 2-2. Grizzlies Isaiah Stewart (ankle) and Karim Lopez (knee bruise) are both day-to-day, with Stewart a game-time decision, while Utah is missing Jusuf Nurkic (foot strain) and Trey Alexander (knee bruise), both out, and Jaxson Hayes (shoulder soreness) is day-to-day and a game-time decision.
